description: This file contains utility functions for traversing and managing Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) states within a PyTorch distributed training context. It includes functions for identifying composable modules, retrieving FSDP states and handles, and performing depth-first traversal of module trees.

methods.name: _composable
methods.description: Determines if a given nn.Module can be composed with fully_shard based on its registry.

methods.name: _get_fsdp_states_with_modules
methods.description: Performs a depth-first traversal of the module tree to collect all _FSDPState instances and their corresponding modules, respecting API compatibility annotations.

methods.name: _get_fsdp_states
methods.description: Returns a list of all _FSDPState instances in the module tree.

methods.name: _get_fsdp_handles
methods.description: Retrieves all FlatParamHandle objects associated with the module tree.
